ex.en: We have optimized the database indexing, and as a result, system efficiency has improved by 50%.
ex.zh: 我們優化了資料庫索引，系統效率因此提高了 50%。

ex.en: We optimized the website so it loads faster.
ex.zh: 我們優化了網站，讓它載入得更快。

ex.en: Being challenged in life is inevitable, being defeated is optional.
ex.zh: 人生中遭遇挑戰無可避免，但要不要被打敗是可以選擇的。

ex.en: Attendance at the workshop is optional.
ex.zh: 工作坊可自由參加。

ex.en: Breakfast is optional and costs extra.
ex.zh: 早餐可自由加購，需另外付費。

ex.en: I am not as optimistic as you are.
ex.zh: 我沒有你那麼樂觀。

ex.en: His view seems to be too optimistic.
ex.zh: 他的看法似乎太樂觀了。

ex.en: We are optimistic about next year's sales.
ex.zh: 我們對明年的銷售很樂觀。

ex.en: Many employees opted to work from home.
ex.zh: 很多員工選擇在家工作。

ex.en: She opted for the cheaper hotel.
ex.zh: 她選了比較便宜的飯店。

ex.en: You can opt out of the newsletter at any time.
ex.zh: 你可以隨時取消訂閱電子報。

ex.en: Few staff opted out of the pension plan.
ex.zh: 很少員工選擇退出退休金計畫。

ex.en: The new factory will be fully operational next month.
ex.zh: 新工廠下個月將全面投入運作。

ex.en: The elevator is not operational at the moment.
ex.zh: 電梯目前無法使用。

ex.en: We need to reduce our operational costs.
ex.zh: 我們需要降低營運成本。

ex.en: The delay was caused by operational problems.
ex.zh: 延誤是營運上的問題造成的。

ex.en: We need to find the optimal solution.
ex.zh: 我們需要找出最佳解決方案。

ex.en: Store the medicine at the optimal temperature.
ex.zh: 請將藥品存放在最適溫度下。

ex.en: Search engine optimization can bring more visitors to our website.
ex.zh: 搜尋引擎最佳化能為我們的網站帶來更多訪客。

ex.en: The new update includes several performance optimizations.
ex.zh: 這次更新包含了幾項效能優化。

ex.en: The new rules will be operative from next month.
ex.zh: 新規定將從下個月起生效。

ex.en: The factory is now fully operative.
ex.zh: 這座工廠現在已全面運作。

ex.en: The factory employs over 200 operatives.
ex.zh: 這座工廠僱用了兩百多名作業員。

ex.en: He worked as a secret operative for years.
ex.zh: 他當了好幾年的秘密特務。

ex.en: There is growing optimism about the economy.
ex.zh: 大家對經濟越來越樂觀。

ex.en: She faced the challenge with optimism.
ex.zh: 她以樂觀的態度面對挑戰。

ex.en: We should discuss the problem openly.
ex.zh: 我們應該公開討論這個問題。

ex.en: She spoke openly about her mistakes.
ex.zh: 她坦率地談論自己犯的錯。

ex.en: The optimum temperature for this plant is 25 degrees.
ex.zh: 這種植物的最適溫度是 25 度。

ex.en: We need to find the optimum price for the product.
ex.zh: 我們需要找出這項產品的最佳售價。

ex.en: As soon as the door opened, they ran away.
ex.zh: 門一開，他們就跑掉了。

ex.en: Can you open the window?
ex.zh: 你可以打開窗戶嗎？

ex.en: I left the window open all through the night.
ex.zh: 我整晚都開著窗戶。

ex.en: The door is open.
ex.zh: 門是開著的。

ex.en: Is the bank open on Saturday?
ex.zh: 銀行星期六有營業嗎？

ex.en: The store is open 24 hours.
ex.zh: 這家店24小時營業。

ex.en: A new café opened near my office.
ex.zh: 我辦公室附近開了一家新咖啡館。

ex.en: The museum opens at nine.
ex.zh: 博物館九點開門。

open.zh: 公開的、開放的；願意接受的

ex.en: The event is open to the public.
ex.zh: 這場活動開放給一般民眾參加。

ex.en: I'm open to suggestions.
ex.zh: 我很樂意聽取建議。

ex.en: We have few opportunities to speak German.
ex.zh: 我們很少有機會說德文。

ex.en: You had better make use of the opportunity.
ex.zh: 你最好好好利用這個機會。

ex.en: He made use of the opportunity to improve his English.
ex.zh: 他利用這個機會提升英文能力。

ex.en: I had an operation for glaucoma last year.
ex.zh: 我去年動了青光眼手術。

ex.en: My father has been in good shape since his operation.
ex.zh: 我父親手術後身體一直很好。

ex.en: Doctors refused to perform a second operation.
ex.zh: 醫生拒絕做第二次手術。

ex.en: The first electronic computers went into operation in 1945.
ex.zh: 最早的電子計算機在 1945 年開始運作。

ex.en: The factory has been in operation for 30 years.
ex.zh: 這間工廠已經營運三十年了。

ex.en: Branching and merging are two basic operations of revision control.
ex.zh: 分支和合併是版本控制的兩種基本操作。

ex.en: The operation of this machine is simple.
ex.zh: 這台機器的操作很簡單。

ex.en: I don't have a lot of options.
ex.zh: 我沒有太多選擇。

ex.en: You only have two options.
ex.zh: 你只有兩個選項。

ex.en: What are my options?
ex.zh: 我有哪些選擇？

ex.en: The company has an option to buy the building.
ex.zh: 公司擁有購買這棟大樓的選擇權。

ex.en: Employees can receive stock options after one year.
ex.zh: 員工滿一年後可以獲得認股權。

ex.en: Do you know how to operate a computer?
ex.zh: 你知道怎麼操作電腦嗎？

ex.en: I don't know how to operate this computer.
ex.zh: 我不知道怎麼操作這台電腦。

ex.en: The company operates in over 20 countries.
ex.zh: 這家公司在二十多個國家營運。

ex.en: The shuttle bus operates every 30 minutes.
ex.zh: 接駁車每三十分鐘一班。

ex.en: I got a stomach tumor and had to have it operated on.
ex.zh: 我胃裡長了腫瘤，必須動手術切除。

ex.en: The doctors operated on him for five hours.
ex.zh: 醫生為他動了五個小時的手術。

ex.en: He opposes racism.
ex.zh: 他反對種族歧視。

ex.en: Mariko's parents are strongly opposed to her marrying an American.
ex.zh: 麻理子的父母強烈反對她嫁給美國人。

ex.en: Everyone opposed it, but they got married all the same.
ex.zh: 大家都反對，但他們還是結婚了。

oppose.zh: as opposed to：而不是、與…相對

ex.en: Red, as opposed to green, is a sign of danger.
ex.zh: 紅色和綠色相反，代表危險。

ex.en: We need action, as opposed to words.
ex.zh: 我們需要的是行動，而不是空談。

ex.en: In the teeth of their strong opposition, we carried out our plan.
ex.zh: 儘管他們強烈反對，我們還是執行了計畫。

ex.en: There is strong opposition to the new tax.
ex.zh: 新稅制遭到強烈反對。

ex.en: The manager shouted out to his players to mark the opposition.
ex.zh: 教練大喊要球員盯住對手。

ex.en: The opposition formed a line in the box to try and block Messi from scoring.
ex.zh: 對方球員在禁區內排成一道防線，想阻止梅西射門。

ex.en: The opposition criticized the new budget.
ex.zh: 在野黨批評新的預算案。

ex.en: The opposition party called for an early election.
ex.zh: 反對黨要求提前舉行選舉。

ex.en: Mary was a switchboard operator when she was younger.
ex.zh: 瑪麗年輕時是電話總機接線生。

ex.en: The telephone operator asked the caller to hold on until a connection was made.
ex.zh: 電話接線生請來電者稍候，直到接通為止。

ex.en: Only trained operators can use this machine.
ex.zh: 只有受過訓練的操作員才能使用這台機器。

operator.zh: 業者、經營者（旅遊、電信等）

ex.en: The tour operator canceled our trip.
ex.zh: 旅行社取消了我們的行程。

ex.en: Mobile operators are lowering their prices.
ex.zh: 電信業者紛紛降價。

ex.en: Our team defeated our opponent 5-4.
ex.zh: 我們隊以 5 比 4 擊敗對手。

ex.en: The home team always have an advantage over their opponents.
ex.zh: 主場球隊總是比對手占優勢。

ex.en: He is superior to his opponents in all respects.
ex.zh: 他在各方面都勝過對手。

ex.en: He is a strong opponent of the new tax.
ex.zh: 他強烈反對新稅制。

ex.en: Opponents of the plan say it costs too much.
ex.zh: 反對這項計畫的人說它太花錢了。

ex.en: This is an opera in five acts.
ex.zh: 這是一部五幕歌劇。

ex.en: She's a fan of Italian opera.
ex.zh: 她是義大利歌劇迷。

ex.en: Maria Callas was a famous opera singer.
ex.zh: 瑪麗亞‧卡拉絲是一位著名的歌劇演唱家。

ex.en: I like watching Korean soap operas.
ex.zh: 我很喜歡看韓國連續劇。

ex.en: My mom watches a soap opera every evening.
ex.zh: 我媽每天晚上都看連續劇。

ex.en: The camera has a powerful optical zoom.
ex.zh: 這台相機有很強的光學變焦。

ex.en: Optical fiber carries data at high speed.
ex.zh: 光纖能高速傳輸資料。

ex.en: This picture is a famous optical illusion.
ex.zh: 這張圖是很有名的視覺錯覺。

ex.en: The moving lines are just an optical illusion.
ex.zh: 那些線看起來在動，其實只是錯覺。

ex.en: It is on this point that our opinions differ.
ex.zh: 我們的意見就是在這一點上有分歧。

ex.en: He is always very respectful of his wife's opinions.
ex.zh: 他總是很尊重妻子的意見。

ex.en: The whole plan is only based on his personal opinions.
ex.zh: 整個計畫只是根據他的個人看法。

ex.en: The boss has a good opinion of your work.
ex.zh: 老闆對你的工作評價很高。

ex.en: She doesn't have a very high opinion of him.
ex.zh: 她對他評價不高。

ex.en: The bank is opposite the post office.
ex.zh: 銀行在郵局對面。

ex.en: She sat opposite me at dinner.
ex.zh: 吃晚餐時她坐在我對面。

ex.en: The result is opposite to what we expected.
ex.zh: 結果與我們預期的相反。

ex.en: They walked off in opposite directions.
ex.zh: 他們朝相反的方向走開了。

ex.en: He is honest and hard-working, but his brother is the exact opposite.
ex.zh: 他誠實又勤奮，他弟弟卻正好相反。

ex.en: You say one thing and then act just the opposite.
ex.zh: 你說的是一回事，做的卻完全相反。

ex.en: What are the museum's opening hours?
ex.zh: 博物館的開放時間是幾點到幾點？

ex.en: Opening hours may change during the holidays.
ex.zh: 假日期間營業時間可能會調整。
